newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-MEN'S ALPINE SUPER-G POSTPONED.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-MEN'S ALPINE SUPER-G POSTPONED.

text.p: The International Ski Federation said on Sunday it had been forced to postpone a men's alpine World Cup super giant slalom that had been added to the programme in Chamonix, France.

The postponement of the race, originally scheduled for December 8 in Whistler, Canada, came a day after it was announced it had been rescheduled for January 10 ahead of a downhill and slalom at the French resort.
Race organisers later informed the FIS they could not guarantee a third course would be ready for the new date.
